component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.signature
component.documentation:
The e-signature service: the providers a server may send files to, each registered here by an id and a class implementing org.nuxeo.agentic.signature.SignatureProvider, and the one the server uses, which its nuxeo.conf names in nuxeo.agentic.signature.provider. With none named, or the one named not configured, nothing is sent and every request is refused. A provider's own settings, its address and its credentials, are server settings, under nuxeo.agentic.signature.(provider id).*, never in a contribution, a document or a request.
Each provider's callback is answered at /nuxeo/agentic-signature/callback/(provider id), by CallbackServlet, with no sign-in: the provider authenticates it, and only then is it read.

extension-point.name: providers
extension-point.documentation: An e-signature provider, by its id, 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and "-", starting with a letter, which its callback path names, and its class. enabled="false" removes one.
